lines.text: The Israelites camped at Rephidim, where there was no water, and the people grumbled against Moses.
The LORD told Moses to take the staff and strike the rock at Sinai, and water would come out.
The Amalekites attacked at Rephidim, so Joshua fought them while Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up the hill.
When Moses' hands grew heavy, Aaron and Hur held them up, one on each side, until the moon went down.
The LORD told Moses to write on a scroll, and Moses named his altar The LORD Is My Banner.
